results.statement: For a finite-dimensional unital bilinear algebra with alternating associator, global associativity is equivalent to vanishing of the associator on every unordered primitive basis triad.
In the octonion n=7 counterexample, exactly 28 of 35 unordered imaginary basis triads have nonzero associator, while the 7 Fano-line triads associate; [e1,e2,e4]=2e7 is an explicit triad witness.

Under alternativity, two-generator coherence is strictly below the needed arity, while vanishing of all primitive three-history associators is sufficient only because it is a finite coefficient form of global associativity; using it without an independent PDT derivation would be circular.
Derive or falsify a PDT-native three-history path-independence/resource law without postulating associativity in equivalent language; seek an operational cost or falsifiable inequality.
